initial.title: [v0.92.1][runtime][gcp] Configure Polis to use Vertex AI
initial.goal: Configure Polis on GCP to use Vertex AI through the governed Runtime/provider configuration path.

C-SDLC v2 remains live authority until #505 cutover is explicitly approved
No raw gh route is permitted for this canary

Do not print copy commit or retain credential material
Do not perform live paid GCP calls without later explicit authorization
Keep all canary evidence in the repository/worktree, not /private/tmp
initial.task_boundary: Exactly one future Polis GCP Vertex AI configuration task plus pre-cutover tooling canary evidence.
deliverables: Explicit Vertex AI provider configuration plan
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: #528 is terminal before execution begins
AC-2: Polis GCP configuration uses Vertex AI through explicit provider configuration, not ambient defaults
AC-3: Vertex AI project location model and credential sourcing are documented and redacted
AC-4: Runtime/provider validation proves the configured route without printing or committing secrets
AC-5: Failure modes distinguish missing credentials disabled Vertex APIs project/location mismatch quota/auth errors and model errors
AC-6: Evidence captures the pre-cutover tooling canary defects found while creating and bootstrapping this real issue

initial.plan_summary: After #528 is terminal, configure Polis for explicit Vertex AI provider use, document redacted GCP credential/project/location/model sourcing, prove failure modes, and retain canary evidence.

steps.action: Verify #528 terminal truth through typed C-SDLC readback before binding execution.
Design explicit Vertex AI provider configuration for Polis on GCP.
Implement the bounded configuration path after dependency clearance.
Validate redaction and distinct Vertex AI failure modes without secret exposure.

invariants: Credentials are never printed or committed
